thread:
Maya (acct exec): Heads-up — enterprise POC in eu-central hit a 5xx storm during a capacity ramp. Demo in 2h. Need a quick triage and short-term mitigation.
Diego (solutions): Is this on Dedicated or Hosted? Any routing across regions?
Maya (acct exec): Dedicated trial in our eu cluster, org trial-eu-77. They ramped concurrency from 20 -> 200 in <3m.
Priya (support): Got log pointers? Also what SDK version and retry policy? Those retries can turn transient 502s into waves.
Maya (acct exec): SDK v1.4.1 default retries 2. They turned on client-side warmup calls which bombarded us.
Jordan (eng-oncall): Looking at logs now. Quick snippet:
```
[2026-03-21T15:02:10Z] ERROR router: 502 backend_overloaded org=trial-eu-77 queued=340 cap_headroom=2
[2026-03-21T15:02:11Z] WARN autoscaler: warmup_pending=true scale_latency=45s requested_gpus=3
[2026-03-21T15:02:12Z] ERROR service: retry_amplification detected retries=3 pattern=burst
```
Jordan (eng-oncall): Root cause appears to be: very low capacity_headroom on dedicated pool + aggressive client warmups + autoscaler cold-start ~40s. That combo produced sustained 502/503.
Priya (support): Immediate mitigations we can push now:
- Apply per-org circuit-breaker on router to reject >120 concurrent requests with 429 (helps break retry loops).
- Add a temporary 2-GPU reservation for trial-eu-77.
- Turn off client warmup in recommended SDK snippet and ask client to backoff retries.
- Enable degraded fallback to smaller model (raven-lite) for requests queued >400ms.
Diego (solutions): Circuit-breaker sounds safe — how do we apply?
Jordan (eng-oncall): CLI to apply breaker and reserve:```
rictl policy set --org trial-eu-77 --circuit_breaker "max_concurrency:120,window_s:10"
rictl reserve --org trial-eu-77 --gpus 2 --ttl 2h
```
infra-bot: policy:set: success (applied in 5s)
infra-bot: reserve: success (reserved 2 GPUs for trial-eu-77 until 2h)
Priya (support): Also pushed an advisory to the customer: disable SDK warmup and change retry behavior to exponential backoff with jitter and max_retries=1. Sample patch we sent:
```js
// recommended SDK client changes for demos
client.setRetryPolicy({maxRetries:1, backoffMs:200, jitter:true});
client.disableWarmup();
```
Maya (acct exec): Customer accepted those changes and reduced concurrency to 110 while we monitor. They asked about pricing for temporary reservation.
Diego (solutions): We'll route billing question to Sales Ops; for demo urgency we can approve a short overage and reconcile later. Also plan: update runbook to request reservations for demos >100 concurrency.
Jordan (eng-oncall): Post-incident fixes to prevent recurrence:
- Add a pre-demo pre-warm task in sales playbook that automatically reserves minimal GPUs.
- Add a capacity_headroom alert to notify when headroom < 10 for any dedicated org.
- Consider shaving autoscaler cold-start by keeping a warm standby for flagged demo orgs.
Priya (support): Monitoring now. Early signal: after circuit-breaker and reservation errors dropped to baseline within 90s. Will attach metrics to ticket TCK-882.
Maya (acct exec): Thank you all. Please send a short incident summary and recommended playbook changes — customer wants a one-pager.
infra-bot: monitor: alert muted for trial-eu-77 until 3190004811
Diego (solutions): I'll draft the one-pager: timeline, root cause, immediate mitigations, billing note, and runbook checklist.
Priya (support): Closing this thread for the immediate demo. Will append final notes once monitoring window closes.
Jordan (eng-oncall): Follow-up action: add circuit-breaker example to SDK docs and add demo reservation API to Sales Ops checklist.
Maya (acct exec): Great, team. Appreciate the quick response. :raised_hands:
